evals.expected_output: A structured report with ## Change Review header, severity counts, and findings categorized as Critical/Warnings/Suggestions. Each finding must include a file:line reference and a concrete Suggestion.

evals.prompt: do a self-review on what i've written so far before i commit
evals.expected_output: Either a structured findings report (if issues exist) or a clear 'No issues found — changes look clean.' message. Must not hallucinate issues on a clean diff.
The skill triggers correctly from the nickname trigger phrase. Produces the same structured change-review report as any other invocation.
